subject: [PATCH] f2fs: opt in to multigrain timestamps

reviews.author: Jeff Layton
reviews.summary: Posted an initial patch with changes to f2fs_setattr() and f2fs_fs_type to enable multigrain timestamps. Addressed the exception for CONFIG_F2FS_FS_POSIX_ACL builds.

2026-10-12.patch_summary: This patch enables multigrain timestamps for the f2fs file system by setting FS_MGTIME on f2fs_fs_type and making changes to f2fs_setattr() to honor ATTR_CTIME_SET when CONFIG_F2FS_FS_POSIX_ACL is enabled.
